provisional_corrections.reason: Workbook route labels say Ballina; OurAirports uses BNK.

notes: Passenger trips are flight stages, not unique people.
City pairs combine both directions; no directional flows are inferred.
Endpoint sums count each route at both ends and describe disclosed routes only.
Domestic stages of Australian international flights are included in the workbook scope.
Null annual totals are unavailable; monthly_status retains any explicit withholding status.
Cartogram anchor coordinates are presentation choices, not traffic locations.
Rates ending in _pct store 19.5 for 19.5%; do not apply fractional percent formatting.
Publisher freshness and the Ballina crosswalk remain release checks.
